name: One Voice
description: Count to the target together, two voices at once and it's back to one.

rules.message:
We're going to count to 20, together, as one voice.

Anyone can tap the next number, anytime. But if two people tap at almost the same moment, we start over from zero.

The rules: no pointing at who should go next, no turn order, no talking strategy. Just feel the room.

(Big classes restart a LOT. That's the game.)

story.template:
Our story:

The target: {{count.target}}.
Attempts: {{count.attempts}} · Restarts: {{count.resets}}
Our longest run as one voice: {{count.bestRun}}.

Every restart was the whole room learning the same lesson: listen more, rush less.

Nobody won. Everybody did.
